definitions.explanation: Describing a slow, gentle swinging or rocking motion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{炎|ほのお}→炎：03724_honoo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ゆらゆら⟦{揺|ゆ}れている→揺れる：01161_yureru⟧。
⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ゆらゆら⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{揺|ゆ}れた→揺れる：01161_yureru⟧。
⟦{水面|すいめん}→水面：04307_suimen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ゆらゆら⟦{映|うつ}る→映る：12964_utsuru⟧⟦{影|かげ}→影：02191_kage⟧。
examples.english: Shadows wavering on the water's surface.

examples.japanese: ⟦ろうそく→蝋燭：05490_rousoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{火|ひ}→火：02248_hi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ゆらゆら⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{光|ひか}っている→光る：01163_hikaru⟧。
examples.english: The candle flame is flickering gently.
Blown by the wind, the tree branches were swaying gently.

notes:
ゆらゆら is an onomatopoeic (mimetic) word describing slow, gentle, rhythmic swaying or wavering motion.

USAGE:
- As adverb: ゆらゆら⟦{揺|ゆ}れる→揺れる：01161_yureru⟧ (to sway gently)
- With ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: ゆらゆら⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be swaying)
- With ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: ゆらゆら⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ (more literary)

TYPICAL SUBJECTS:
- ⟦{炎|ほのお}→炎：03724_honoo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ゆらゆら: flames flickering
- ⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ゆらゆら: boat rocking gently
- ⟦{影|かげ}→影：02191_kage⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ゆらゆら: shadows wavering
- ⟦{水草|みずくさ}→水草：28853_mizukusa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ゆらゆら: water plants swaying

RELATED WORDS:
⟦{揺|ゆ}れる→揺れる：01161_yureru⟧ (to shake/sway) is the related verb. ゆらゆら emphasizes the slow, gentle, back-and-forth quality of the motion.
